install: ([ -x .venv/bin/python ] || python3 -m venv .venv) && .venv/bin/python -m pip install --no-input -r requirements.txt -r requirements-dev.txt && (sed -i '/case \$- in/,/esac/d' ~/.bashrc 2>/dev/null || true) && LINE="export PATH=\"$PWD/.venv/bin:\$PATH\"" && (grep -qxF "$LINE" ~/.bashrc || echo "$LINE" >> ~/.bashrc)
